name: Library
description: Central library for students and faculty with books, journals and study spaces.
help_text: If you cannot find the Library, contact the nearest SWC volunteer.

name: Central Mess
description: Main dining facility serving breakfast, lunch, snacks and dinner.
help_text: Contact the mess office for meal timings or special meal requests.

name: Hostel Office
description: Office handling hostel allocation, room changes and student accommodation.
help_text: Visit during office hours for hostel-related assistance.

name: Medical Centre
description: Campus healthcare facility providing medical consultation and first aid.
help_text: Visit immediately in case of illness or injury.

name: Security Office
description: Campus security office for emergencies and safety assistance.

name: Academic Block
description: Main academic building containing classrooms, lecture halls and faculty offices.
directions: Located at the centre of the campus.
help_text: Check your timetable before visiting classrooms.

name: Main Gate
description: Primary entrance and exit point of IIT Jodhpur.
directions: Located on the main access road to the campus.
help_text: Visitors should carry a valid ID card.

name: Sports Complex
description: Sports facility with indoor and outdoor games, gymnasium and fitness area.
directions: Located near the student activity area.
help_text: Carry your institute ID while using sports facilities.

name: Student Activity Center
description: Venue for clubs, student events, cultural activities and meetings.
directions: Located close to the Academic Block.
help_text: Visit for club registrations and student activities.

name: SBI ATM
description: ATM facility for cash withdrawal and banking services.
help_text: Contact the bank branch if the ATM is unavailable.
